event.name: Houston Spring Break 2027 | College Mansion, Pool & Yacht Parties Mar 10-28

refund_policy.refund_policy_description: Refunds up to 7 days before event

ticket_classes.name: Week 1 Party Pack
ticket_classes.description: One ticket, all 9 Week 1 parties — Thursday through Sunday, March 11 – 14, 2027. Includes the Booze Boat with open bar (21+), Pretty Nasty, Brunch + Day Party (21+), Splash City HTX pool party, Houston Gone Wild, Saturday Day Party, Freaknik HTX, Sunday Day Party (21+) and March Madness (21+). Bought one by one those events run about $225. Venue is announced the week of the event — mansion and pool party addresses stay private until then. Ticket holders get the address by email and in the official GroupMe first.
